source: printed page 46 (folio, page 1 of the chapter PDF) read off the render — the unlabeled kavi-parichay + kruti-parichay paragraphs open the page (M1.S1.T1), then the single continuous 16-line urmikavya 'હાથ મેળવીએ' runs top to bottom with no printed kadi breaks, cut on its own turns of address/image into four topics in printed order: lines 1-5 invitation-and-question (M1.S2.T2), lines 6-9 refusal-and-fullness turn (M1.S2.T3), lines 10-13 warmth-and-heartbeat picture (M1.S2.T4), lines 14-16 plus the source line ('છંદોલય'માંથી) stranger-address and circular close (M1.S2.T5); this is also the chapter's only logical reading order.
